def parse_filename\(filename, course_folder\):
    """Parse filename and generate new name"""
    base_name = os.path.splitext\(filename\)[0]

    if ext not in ['.wav', '.mp3']:

    }

    gd_match = re.search\(r'G\(\\d+\)[_\\-\\s]*D\(\\d+\)', base_name, re.IGNORECASE\)
    if gd_match:
        result['grade'] = int\(gd_match.group\(1\)\)
        result['day'] = int\(gd_match.group\(2\)\)
    
    # Extract BPM \(number typically 60-200\)
    bpm_match = re.search\(r'\\b\([6789]\\d|1[0-4]\\d|150|160|1[789]\\d|200\)\\b', base_name\)
    if bpm_match:
        result['bpm'] = bpm_match.group\(1\)
    
    # Extract key \(letter + optional modifiers like m, mi, maj, #, b\)
    key_match = re.search\(r'\\b\([A-G]\(?:#|b\)?\(?:m|mi|maj\)?\)\\b', base_name\)
    if key_match:
        result['key'] = key_match.group\(1\)
    
    # Extract exercise
    ex_patterns = [
        \(r'Ex\(\\d\).*?\(?:Jam|jam\)?', 'ex'\),
        \(r'Exercise\\s+\(\\d\)', 'ex'\),
        \(r'track[_\\s]?\(\\d\)', 'track'\),
        \(r'\(?:Jam|JAM|jam\)', 'jam'\)
    ]
    
    for pattern, ex_type in ex_patterns:
        ex_match = re.search\(pattern, base_name, re.IGNORECASE\)
        if ex_match:
            if ex_type == 'ex':
                result['exercise'] = f"Ex{ex_match.group\(1\)}"
            elif ex_type == 'track':
                result['exercise'] = f"Ex{ex_match.group\(1\)}"
                result['flags'].append\("track_mapped_to_ex"\)
            elif ex_type == 'jam':
                result['exercise'] = "Jam"
            break
    
    # Check for v2/V2 version
    if re.search\(r'\\b[Vv]2\\b', base_name\):
        result['flags'].append\("v2_version"\)
    
    # Check for "Don't Use"
    if re.search\(r'\\\(Don[\\'´]?t\\s*[Uu]se\\\)', base_name, re.IGNORECASE\):
        result['flags'].append\("dont_use"\)
        return result
    
    # Extract description
    temp = re.sub\(r'[Gg]\\d+[_\\-\\s]*[Dd]\\d+', '', base_name\)
    temp = re.sub\(r'^Bass[_\\-\\s]*', '', temp\)
    temp = re.sub\(r'^FUNK_BASS[_\\-\\s]*', '', temp\)
    temp = re.sub\(r'^ROCK_BASS[_\\-\\s]*', '', temp\)
    temp = re.sub\(r'^[Bb]ass[_\\-]*[Ll][Pp][_\\-]*\\d+[_\\-]*\(?:Funk|Rock\)[_\\-\\s]*', '', temp\)
    if result['bpm']:
        temp = re.sub\(rf'{result["bpm"]}\\b', '', temp\)
    if result['key']:
        temp = re.sub\(rf'\\b{re.escape\(result["key"]\)}\\b', '', temp\)
    temp = re.sub\(r'\(?:Ex|ex|EX\)\\d+.*?$', '', temp\)
    temp = re.sub\(r'\(?:Jam|JAM|jam\)', '', temp\)
    temp = re.sub\(r'Exercise\\s+\\d.*?$', '', temp, flags=re.IGNORECASE\)
    temp = re.sub\(r'track[_\\s]?\\d.*?$', '', temp, flags=re.IGNORECASE\)
    temp = re.sub\(r'\\s*[Vv]2\\b', '', temp\)
    temp = re.sub\(r'\\\(.*?\\\)', '', temp\)
    temp = re.sub\(r'\\s+', '_', temp\)
    temp = re.sub\(r'_+', '_', temp\)
    temp = temp.strip\('_'\).strip\(\)
    
    if temp:
        result['description'] = temp
    
    return result

def generate_new_name\(parsed, prefix, ext\):
    """Generate new filename from parsed data"""
    
    if 'dont_use' in parsed['flags']:
        return None
    
    if not parsed['grade'] or not parsed['day'] or not parsed['description'] or not parsed['bpm'] or not parsed['key']:
        return None
    
    parts = [
        f"G{parsed['grade']}",
        f"D{parsed['day']}",
        parsed['description'],
        parsed['bpm'],
        parsed['key']
    ]
    
    if parsed['exercise']:
        parts.append\(parsed['exercise']\)
    
    if 'v2_version' in parsed['flags']:
        parts.append\('v2'\)
    
    new_base = '-'.join\(parts\)
    return f"{prefix}-{new_base}{ext}"

# Process files
renames = []
skipped = []
errors = []

for root, dirs, files in os.walk\(base_path\):
    course = 'FUNK BASS' if 'FUNK BASS' in root else \('ROCK BASS' if 'ROCK BASS' in root else None\)
    
    if not course:

    prefix = prefixes[course]

# Print summary

print\(f"📋 PREVIEW — RENOMEAÇÃO DE PICKUP TRACKS"\)

print\(f"✅ Prontos para renomear: {len\(renames\)} arquivos"\)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import os
import re

base_path = "/Users/rafa/Downloads/PICKUP rename"

# Step 1: Walk and collect all audio files
audio_files = []
for root, dirs, files in os.walk\(base_path\):
    course = None
    if 'FUNK BASS' in root:
        course = 'FUNK BASS'
    elif 'ROCK BASS' in root:
        course = 'ROCK BASS'
    
    if course:
        for filename in files:
            if filename.endswith\(\('.wav', '.mp3'\)\) and not filename.startswith\('.'\):
                audio_files.append\({
                    'path': os.path.join\(root, filename\),
                    'filename': filename,
                    'course': course,
                    'prefix': 'Bass-LP-08-Funk' if course == 'FUNK BASS' else 'Bass-LP-09-Rock'
                }\)

# Step 2: Parse each file
def smart_parse\(filename, course\):
    base = os.path.splitext\(filename\)[0]
    ext = os.path.splitext\(filename\)[1].lower\(\)
    
    # Skip "Dont Use"
    if 'Dont' in base or 'dont' in base:
        return {'skip': True, 'reason': 'dont_use'}
    
    result = {'skip': False}
    
    # Find G#D# pattern
    gd = re.search\(r'G\(\\d\)D\(\\d\)', base\)
    result['G'] = int\(gd.group\(1\)\) if gd else None
    result['D'] = int\(gd.group\(2\)\) if gd else None
    
    # Find exercise \(must come BEFORE we try to extract description\)
    ex_match = re.search\(r'Ex\(\\d\)|exercise\\s+\(\\d\)|track[_\\s]\(\\d\)|jam', base, re.I\)
    if ex_match:
        if ex_match.group\(1\):
            result['ex'] = f'Ex{ex_match.group\(1\)}'
        elif ex_match.group\(2\):
            result['ex'] = f'Ex{ex_match.group\(2\)}'
        elif ex_match.group\(3\):
            result['ex'] = f'Ex{ex_match.group\(3\)}'
        else:
            result['ex'] = 'Jam'
    else:
        result['ex'] = None
    
    # Find v2
    result['v2'] = bool\(re.search\(r'\\bv2\\b', base, re.I\)\)
    
    # Now extract BPM and KEY by looking right-to-left
    # Last number is usually key pattern or BPM
    # Pattern: ...Description_KEY_BPM_...
    # or: ...Description_BPM_KEY_...
    
    # Try to find BPM + KEY pattern more carefully
    # Look for: \(word\)_\(number\)_\(letter+mods\)_ at the end
    pattern = r'\(.+?\)_\([A-G]#?m?\(?:aj\)?\)_\(\\d{2,3}\)\(?:_|$| |G\\dD\\d|Ex\)'
    match = re.search\(pattern, base\)
    
    if match:
        result['desc'] = match.group\(1\)
        result['key'] = match.group\(2\)
        result['bpm'] = match.group\(3\)
    else:
        # Fallback: find BPM first \(most reliable\), then key
        bpm_m = re.search\(r'_\(\\d{2,3}\)\(?:_|$\)', base\)
        if bpm_m:
            bpm_idx = bpm_m.start\(\)
            # Key is usually right before BPM
            before_bpm = base[:bpm_idx]
            key_m = re.search\(r'_\([A-G]#?m?\(?:aj\)?\)$', before_bpm\)
            if key_m:
                result['key'] = key_m.group\(1\)
